origin: Self-authored synthetic integer source patterns in generate_fixtures.py
stored_inputs: Only eight JP2 files in frozen/. Raw J2K is extracted from each jp2c payload.

encoder.arguments: -n 6 -mct 0 for gray / -mct 1 for RGB; lossy additionally -I -r 12
encoder.input: P5/P6 PNM, 1024 1024, maxval 255; header and source-sample hashes in canonical manifest

native_reencoding_observation.result: Native x86-64 and ARM64 re-encoded cohorts agreed with each other, but smooth-gray-lossy and noisy-rgb-lossy differed from the original frozen bytes. All other cases and all source samples matched. No timings were accepted from this run.
native_reencoding_observation.interpretation: Floating-point lossy re-encoding is not a canonical-input distribution mechanism. Do not replace frozen inputs with native re-encodings.
